noProject.prompt: Create a new project to get started
noProject.description: You need a project before you can start capturing. Your screenshots and documentation steps will be saved inside the project.

feed.readyDesc: Select a source and start capturing to build your documentation
feed.capturingAutoDesc: Click anywhere on the target window — each click becomes a step
feed.realtimeNote: Screenshots will appear here in real-time as you capture them

coach.sourceDesc: Choose a monitor or a specific window. Screenshots will be taken from the selected source.
coach.modeDesc: Hotkeys capture on command. Auto mode captures on every click — great for building click-by-click tutorials.
coach.startDesc: Kick off the capture session. In Hotkey mode, press the configured key to snap each step.
coach.stopDesc: Ends the capture session. You can then move on to edit and polish your steps.
coach.editDesc: Jump into the editor to refine titles, descriptions, and annotations before exporting.

toast.noSourcesFound: No capturable sources found. Some windows may be protected by the system.
toast.loadSourcesFailed: Failed to load capture sources. Some system windows may be protected.
toast.previewSelectFirst: Please select a capture source first.
toast.previewDesktopOnly: Preview is only available in the desktop app.
toast.previewFailed: Failed to start preview. Please try selecting a different source.
toast.projectFolderFailed: Failed to create project folder structure
toast.desktopRequired: This feature requires the desktop application
toast.noProject: Please select or create a project first
toast.autoCaptureActivated: Auto-capture activated — every click is now captured automatically!
toast.hotkeyCaptureActivated: Screenshot capture mode activated — press hotkey to capture!
